Symbols group events on the shared time axis, not dose size. ×N means N events, not units. Tap a symbol or open the event list for exact times and delivered amounts.

Glucose and insulin chart. Use the controls and insulin event list below for accessible navigation and event details.

The backup contains private health data in unencrypted CSV files. Anyone with access to the folder can read it. Choose or create a local Documents/MGlikemia folder; cloud folders may synchronize your data.

Files in this folder survive app uninstall, but the app’s folder permission does not. After reinstalling, explicitly use Restore from folder and grant access again.

An existing backup folder must be restored before enabling backup there, to protect its contents. Turning backup off does not delete any files.
Choose the folder containing the backup you want to import. Restore is explicit and may add readings and insulin history to this app. Review the result before enabling backup.\n\n%1$s
